S_innovation.available_when: no later than entry endpoint; parameters used to form S must be exit-causal or entry-causal as declared

context_drift_position.available_when: must be computable from exit-causal context only

g_phys.available_when: at candidate entry endpoint (exit already known)

residual_position.available_when: at entry endpoint after mean prediction from exit-causal state

context_definition: Exit-causal context c only; fixed on [0, Δ]; no entry/future frames
context_fallback: if context unavailable, M2 inactive; M0/M1 still legal with d_Δ=0

coordinate_semantics.space: R^{2d} latent state; observed residual is position block R^d

identifiability_limits: P_xx vs R_1 split structurally non-identifiable without gauge_fixing
gamma unknown requires unproven joint-map regime; D1 treats gamma as declared
CAL scale alpha_Delta not identifiable from RANK order
single Hx event cannot identify full {P0,R1,D} quotient

models.M0: frozen deterministic Euclidean residual energy; same residual mean
models.M1: gap-conditioned Mahalanobis/NLL under same mean residual interface
models.M2: optional leakage-free context drift mean correction; observation interface, candidate universe, missing-value rule, normalization, score composition, fitting semantics held fixed

required_runtime_fields.name: event_id
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Stable event key grouping one lost exit with its candidate set

required_runtime_fields.name: cand_id
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Stable candidate identity inside an event

required_runtime_fields.available_when: at candidate entry endpoint (exit already known)
required_runtime_fields.consumed_by_invariant: I6 shared gap condition; M1/M2 parameterization
required_runtime_fields.name: g_phys
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Physical exit→entry gap in frame intervals (canonical Δ)

required_runtime_fields.available_when: at entry endpoint after mean prediction from exit-causal state
required_runtime_fields.name: residual_position
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Position innovation r = y1 - H m^-_Δ under declared mean model; Hx observation mode only

required_runtime_fields.available_when: no later than entry endpoint; parameters used to form S must be exit-causal or entry-causal as declared
required_runtime_fields.name: S_innovation
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Total innovation covariance S_Δ used for Mahalanobis/NLL. Must declare whether event-shared or candidate-specific and the source

required_runtime_fields.name: covariance_semantics
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Enum: isotropic_shared | anisotropic_shared | candidate_specific; source and causal availability of each component

required_runtime_fields.consumed_by_invariant: I6 dimension match; I10 shape checks
required_runtime_fields.name: coordinate_dim_d
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Coordinate dimension d for residual and covariance

required_runtime_fields.name: observation_mode
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Must be H_x for this interface family (position-only)

required_runtime_fields.available_when: must be computable from exit-causal context only
required_runtime_fields.name: context_drift_position
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Optional M2 only: H d_Δ(c) position correction; exit-causal context only

required_runtime_fields.name: score_orientation
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Frozen lower_better for q and NLL native scores

required_runtime_fields.name: true_match_label
required_runtime_fields.semantic_meaning: Diagnostic-only label for RANK metrics on synthetic/sealed non-runtime inputs; not a runtime producer field for online scoring

time_conversion.continuous_dt: dt ≡ 1 frame; wall-clock/fps mapping must be separately declared
